* A class for an SVCB record.
 * https://www.iana.org/assignments/dns-svcb/dns-svcb.xhtml
 * @hide

variables.name: KEY_MANDATORY
variables.comment: The SvcParamKey "mandatory". The associated implementation of SvcParam is SvcParamMandatory.

variables.name: KEY_ALPN
variables.comment: The SvcParamKey "alpn". The associated implementation of SvcParam is SvcParamAlpn.

variables.name: KEY_PORT
variables.comment: The SvcParamKey "port". The associated implementation of SvcParam is SvcParamPort.

variables.name: KEY_IPV4HINT
variables.comment: The SvcParamKey "ipv4hint". The associated implementation of SvcParam is SvcParamIpv4Hint.

variables.name: KEY_ECH
variables.comment: The SvcParamKey "ech". The associated implementation of SvcParam is SvcParamEch.

variables.name: KEY_IPV6HINT
variables.comment: The SvcParamKey "ipv6hint". The associated implementation of SvcParam is SvcParamIpv6Hint.

variables.name: KEY_DOHPATH
variables.comment: The SvcParamKey "dohpath". The associated implementation of SvcParam is SvcParamDohPath.

methods.name: public List<String> getAlpns()
methods.comment: * Returns an unmodifiable list of alpns from SvcParam alpn.

methods.name: public int getPort()
methods.comment: * Returns the port number from SvcParam port.

methods.name: public List<InetAddress> getAddresses()
methods.comment: * Returns a list of the IP addresses from both of SvcParam ipv4hint and ipv6hint.

methods.name: public String getDohPath()
methods.comment: * Returns the doh path from SvcParam dohPath.

methods.name: private static SvcParam parseSvcParam(@NonNull ByteBuffer buf) throws ParseException
public static ByteBuffer sliceAndAdvance(@NonNull ByteBuffer buf, int length) throws BufferUnderflowException
methods.comment:
* Returns a read-only ByteBuffer (with position = 0, limit = `length`, and capacity = `length`)
     * sliced from `buf`'s current position, and moves the position of `buf` by `length`.
